AGHR-001.criterion_ar: ربط القرار بمرجع المطور الرسمي الملائم وتمييز أمثلته عن الالتزام.

positive_case.input: Observable project record satisfying the stated criterion
positive_case.expected: Criterion observed within the exact authorized scope

negative_case.input: Missing or contradictory record for the criterion
negative_case.expected: Refuse success/promotion and preserve the unmet criterion

AGHR-001.scope: Prospective verification data, never a claimed execution or an E4 honesty run
